details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then executes a 727KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript bundle (math_init.js) with it. The bundle is obfuscated with a javascript-obfuscator dictionary-array scheme, making its behavior unreadable, and it is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (converting pnpm audit output to JUnit). The actual CLI logic ships separately in clean dist/ files; math_init.js is only invoked by the install hook. Installing this package executes an opaque, obfuscated payload at install time whose behavior cannot be statically determined.
